title: Revise contrast grid, type scale, and corner rhythm for dense UIs
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Scope: harmonize color contrast ramp, tighten typography scale for 10–14px dense surfaces, standardize spacing/radius families (compact / default / roomy), and simplify shadow/elevation rules for quick visual parsing in tables, charts, and compact controls. Deliverables: token set JSON, Figma component updates, migration guide, automated visual regression baselines, and engineering implementation PRs. Goals: improve perceived information density without losing legibility or a11y, reduce token variance to make QA and rollout safer, and lower cognitive load for product teams when choosing variants.
acceptance_criteria: 1) New token JSON committed and validated against baseline snapshots; 2) Components in Figma reflect new type scale and corner families; 3) Accessibility audit shows AA compliance for primary/secondary text at compact sizes; 4) Migration guide and deprecation window published; 5) Two guinea-pilot product pages (tables + charts) migrated with no regressions in visual tests.
notes: Started exploratory tests to compare compact 11px and 12px body sizes across Chrome/Firefox on macOS and Windows - 2026-02-22
Figma mock for compact table row density uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/Design-System-2026 - file: Token Rhythm > Compact Tables
Initial a11y scan with Axe CLI shows primary text at 11px fails contrast on the lightest background; decided to increase contrast token for compact surfaces by 8% (delta tested) - 2026-03-02
decision_log: Decision: adopt a three-tier radius family (none, micro, standard) instead of previously proposed four-tier to reduce permutations — rationale: engineering rollout complexity and downstream component mapping (buttons/tables/cards) - 2026-03-04
Decision: prefer a narrower type scale with 1.125 modular step for body sizes to keep optical rhythm consistent at small sizes - 2026-03-05
Trade-off: tightening spacing reduces whitespace but increases visual density; compensated with clearer elevation distinction and stronger separators in table rows - 2026-03-07

implementation_plan: 1) Finalize token JSON and run internal token linter; 2) Land Figma updates and annotates components; 3) Open paired engineering PRs for token import + runtime key mapping; 4) Deploy tokens behind a feature flag for two pilot routes; 5) Run automated visual diffs and accessibility checks; 6) Iterate on feedback and schedule full rollout with 2-week deprecation window for old tokens.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: small-size text may fail a11y on older browsers - Mitigation: increase contrast tokens for compact surfaces and document fallbacks
Risk: component mismatch across repos due to token name drift - Mitigation: enforce 1:1 naming and add pre-merge linting
Risk: visual regressions in high-traffic dashboards - Mitigation: pilot deploy behind flag + additional visual diff thresholds for canary
